referents.why: First person singular 'my' (shepherd) in the psalm's own voice; the psalm quotes no one else here.
First person singular 'I shall not want', the psalm's own voice.

groups.why: The superscription is the frame, David is the named writer, and the two lines are its parts.
groups.category: psalm as writing from its writer

cant_tell.what: whether 'I shall not want' (cl2) is a consequence of 'The LORD is my shepherd' (cl1)
cant_tell.why: The lines are set side by side with a semicolon and no conjunction; the sense suggests a reason but the form does not state one.
